relations.text: 原油管ETCOに27.6%出資、新パイプを50%ずつ共同保有へ
relations.text_en: 27.6% of the ETCO crude line; 50/50 owner of a new connector

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: 3 Includes amounts for the construction of the Southern Illinois Connector Pipeline, which is expected to be 50% jointly-owned with Energy Transfer, costs to upgrade the Energy Transfer Crude Oil Pipeline, in which we have a 27.6% ownership interest,

companies.name: ホワイトウォーター・ミッドストリーム

relations.text: ガス管ホイッスラーの合弁(50.6%)の筆頭パートナー
relations.text_en: Lead partner (50.6%) in the Whistler gas pipeline JV

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Whistler Parent JV is owned by WhiteWater/I Squared ( 50.6 %), MPLX ( 30.4 %) and Enbridge ( 19.0 %) and is accounted for as an equity method investment.

relations.text: ホイッスラー合弁(30.4%)とマッターホーン合弁の相手
relations.text_en: Partner in the Whistler (30.4%) and Matterhorn JVs

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Whistler Parent JV is owned by WhiteWater/I Squared ( 50.6 %), MPLX ( 30.4 %) and Enbridge ( 19.0 %) and is accounted for as an equity method investment.

relations.text: ガス管マッターホーン・エクスプレスの合弁相手
relations.text_en: Partner in the Matterhorn Express gas pipeline JV

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The MXP Parent JV, a joint venture formed by Enbridge, WhiteWater Midstream, ONEOK, Inc and MPLX LP, holds (i) a 100% interest in MXP, which owns the Matterhorn Express Pipeline, an approximately 580 mile intrastate pipeline with associated compressor stations that extends from the Permian Basin to the Katy, Texas area with a capacity of 2.5 bcf/d; and (ii) a 70% equity interest in the 3.7 bcf/d Eiger Express Pipeline

relations.text: DCPミッドストリームを50%ずつ共同保有していた

source.label: Phillips 66 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Prior to the DCP Midstream Merger, we and Enbridge each held a 50 % interest and jointly governed DCP Midstream, whose primary assets are its general partner and limited partner interests in DCP Midstream, LP (DCP LP), and we each held indirect economic interests in DCP LP of 28.26 %.

companies.name: ノースカロライナ公益ガス(PSNC)
companies.name_en: Public Service Company of North Carolina

relations.text: ノースカロライナのガス会社を20億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Bought the North Carolina gas utility for US$2.0B

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Public Service Company of North Carolina, Incorporated On September 30, 2024, through a wholly-owned US subsidiary, we acquired all of the membership interests of Fall North Carolina Holdco LLC, which owns 100 % of Public Service Company of North Carolina, Incorporated (PSNC), for cash consideration of $ 2.7 billion (US$ 2.0 billion) (the PSNC Acquisition).

relations.text: ユタ州などのガス会社を30億ドルで買収
relations.text_en: Bought the Utah-based gas utility for US$3.0B

source.label: Enbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Questar Gas Company On May 31, 2024, through a wholly-owned US subsidiary, we acquired all of the membership interests of Fall West Holdco LLC which owns 100 % of Questar and Wexpro for cash consideration of $ 4.1 billion (US$ 3.0 billion) (the Questar Acquisition).
